articles.summary: Third Quarter 2025 Highlights Earnings per diluted share (EPS) from continuing operations of $1.56, up 25%, and adjusted EPS from continuing operations of $1.64, up 27%. Sales of $589.2 million, up 7.5% driven by 5.6% core sales growth. Core order growth up 1.8% and core backlog growth up 16.4%, driven primarily by ongoing strength at Aerospace Electronics.
